# StateFrame

> An Open Agent Engine, built and measured on software engineering work, for local OpenAI-compatible model servers. Every request is rebuilt from system instructions, tools, the task, a typed state frame and the newest exchange, in a fixed 33,344-token budget; no chat history is resent.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): orientation, repository map, install/run/test
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, why it matters, requirements
- [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md): install and first runs

## Guide
- [Concepts](docs/guide/concepts.md): typed state frame, receipts, checkpoints, disk-backed history, determinism
- [Request lifecycle](docs/guide/request-lifecycle.md): how a run and each request are built
- [Code map](docs/guide/code-map.md): which module owns what
- [Running](docs/guide/running.md): commands, flags, test interpreter, profiles, resume
- [Agent tools](docs/guide/tools.md): shell policy, background jobs, file effects, Git, web, custom commands, budget-aware replies, reconciliation limits, replay
- [Extending](docs/guide/extending.md): profiles, tools, switches, tests
- [Troubleshooting](docs/guide/troubleshooting.md): errors and fixes
- [Design rationale](docs/guide/design.md): why it is built this way
